117788.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of British Columbia
117788.note: Lubavitch.com (20 Nov 2005, 'Celebrating 30 Years in Vancouver'): Rabbi Yitzchak and Henia Wineberg 'arrived with one young baby in November 1974 and set about revitalizing the Jewish infrastructure in Vancouver' (the same piece opens 'Thirty years ago this month', which would be 1975). The Jewish Independent (19 Dec 2014, 'Gold Plate celebration'): the dinner 'marks 40 years that Lubavitch B.C. ... has been in Vancouver'. Headquarters now 5750 Oak Street (since when not found).

118190.name: Centre for Judaism of the Lower Fraser Valley
118190.note: Its entry in the Jewish Federation's directory: 'From 1987 to the present, Chabad Lubavitch has been servicing the Jewish community of Surrey, Delta, White Rock, Langley, Abbotsford and beyond ... Since 1996 it operates under the name Centre for Judaism and is based in the Ocean Park neighborhood of South Surrey/White Rock.' Medium: whether shluchim lived there from 1987 or served it from Vancouver isn't said; Lubavitch.com (Nov 2005) counts White Rock among the satellite centres that 'opened their doors in recent years'. Rabbi Falik and Simie Schtroks, co-directors (Jewish Independent, Jan 2018). (The White Rock South Surrey JCC, opened Sept 21 2003, is another body.)

118276.name: Chabad Richmond
118276.note: The Jewish Independent (6 May 2022, 'Celebrating 25 years'): 'Freilach25, which marks Chabad Richmond's 25th anniversary' (gala June 19 2022), so 1997. The same piece: the Baitelmans' journey 'began in October 1993', when Rabbi Yitzchak Wineberg brought them to Vancouver as shluchim of Lubavitch BC; 'in 2000, the Baitelmans went out on their own, when people asked for a Chabad centre in Richmond', keeping some Lubavitch BC duties for ten years. Rabbi Yechiel and Chanie Baitelman.

118610.name: Chabad of Vancouver Island
118610.note: Chabad.org (Mindy Rubenstein, on CrownHeights.info 24 Sept 2017): 'Chabad-Lubavitch emissaries Rabbi Meir and Chani Kaplan settled in Victoria in 2003 ... "We started out like many shluchim, working from our living room"'; the new 10,000-square-foot centre (2955 Glasgow Street) opened about Sept 2016 ('It's been a year since the doors of a brand-new Jewish center opened'). Also: its 20th anniversary in Nov 2023.

earlier.where: the Kaplans' home ('working from our living room')

314635.name: Chabad of Downtown
314635.note: The Western Jewish Bulletin (25 Nov 2005, 'Lubavitch grows into the downtown core'): 'There is finally a centre for Judaism in the downtown core ... at the home of Rabbi Binyomin Bitton and his wife, Malky. Bitton, who came to Vancouver to join forces with Lubavitch B.C. last year, moved downtown this summer and began setting up multiple programs' (based in Yaletown). The Jewish Independent (17 Oct 2008, 'Strathcona once more'): 'Three years ago, the couple started Chabad in Yaletown'; 'Four months ago, Rabbi Binyomin Bitton and his family purchased a house' in Strathcona. Now 1260 Howe Street (since when not found).

1261478.name: Chabad East Van
1261478.note: No founding source found; the listing names no director. Its chabad.org listing went up on July 29 2010, so it existed by then. A registered charity, 'Chabad East Van - Centre for Jewish Life' (CanadaHelps), at 4310 Fraser Street.

1365280.name: The Okanagan Chabad House
1365280.note: Chabad.org (Menachem Posner, on CrownHeights.info 21 Sept 2016): Hecht 'has lived with his family in Kelowna since 2010'; 'Rabbi Shmuly and Fraidy Hecht, co-directors of Chabad-Lubavitch Okanagan in Kelowna since 2010'. The Jewish Independent (12 May 2023): settling in the B.C. Interior 'more than 12 years ago'. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 24 2010. (A Chabad.org piece of Sept 2013 calls it 'the two-year-old Chabad-Lubavitch of the Okanagan'.) Now 795 Birch Avenue.

2026603.name: Chabad Jewish Student Centre - Vancouver
2026603.note: The Jewish Independent: the Chabad Jewish Student Centre at UBC 'was established in 2013 by Rabbi Chalom and Esti Loeub'; again (9 June 2023, 'UBC Chabad celebrates 10th'): 'This year marks a milestone' (10th anniversary). The earliest Wayback capture of chabadubc.com is May 16 2013. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 4 2012, ahead of that.

3118301.name: Chabad of Nanaimo
3118301.note: The Jewish Independent (11 Dec 2015, 'New Chabad houses'): Rabbi Bentzion (Bentzi) and Blumie Shemtov 'arrived in Victoria on Oct. 20, where they stayed briefly with her brother, Rabbi Meir Kaplan ... On Nov. 10, they moved fully into their house' in Nanaimo; before that Rabbi Kaplan drove up to light the menorah.

5599806.name: Chabad of the Tri-Cities
5599806.note: The Jewish Independent (28 June 2024, 'Tri-Cities community grows'): 'Gurevitz, a Brooklyn native, arrived in the Tri-Cities in November 2022 with his wife, Nechama'. Its chabad.org listing went up Oct 24 2022. Rabbi Mordechai (Mottel) and Nechama Gurevitz; Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam and Port Moody.

6887507.name: Chabad of Whistler
6887507.note: The Jewish Independent (24 July 2026, 'Whistler welcomes Chabad'): Rabbi Schneur and Bina Druk 'arrived last September' after a first visit at Hanukkah 2024. CrownHeights.info (25 Aug 2025): they are 'moving out on Shlichus to Whistler' to open Chabad of Whistler and Squamish. Its chabad.org listing went up May 9 2025. (From 2015 Chabad of the North Shore also served Whistler.)

7009926.name: Chabad on Campus Victoria
7009926.note: CrownHeights.info (10 Nov 2025, 'New Chabad Center at University of Victoria'): 'Now, Jewish students across those campuses have something new: a dedicated Chabad presence led by Rabbi Mendy and Mushka Stiefel' (UVic, Royal Roads, Camosun). Its chabad.org listing went up Sept 10 2025. Mushka Stiefel is a Kaplan, of Chabad of Vancouver Island.

7011661.name: Chabad of the North Shore
7011661.note: The Jewish Independent (11 Dec 2015, 'New Chabad houses'): 'In early September, just in time for the High Holy Days, Rabbi Mendel Mochkin, his wife Miki and their three young children arrived in West Vancouver to begin their outreach work on the North Shore, as well as in Squamish and Whistler' ('Chabad of North Shore'). Medium: the listing now names Rabbi Mordechai Slavin (North Vancouver; listing published Sept 10 2025), and whether his centre carries on the Mochkins' wasn't found.
